responsibility: Contains the core System z vector-facility RTL machine description, including mode iterators and instruction patterns for native vector arithmetic, permutes, compares, conversions, byte swaps, TF-in-vector-register handling, len_load/len_store support, and NNPA-related operations. It is the backend’s principal non-builtin vector pattern file, used by generic RTL expansion and optimization once vector modes and target features are enabled.
